result.keyword: What's the best CRM for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **HubSpot** as the best overall CRM. It's relatively easy to learn, has a useful free version, and can grow with your business.

However, the best choice depends on whether you're managing sales leads, customer relationships, projects, or marketing.

## My top 5 CRM recommendations

![HubSpot + Outbound Best Practices: How to Build a Predictable Pipeline Engine](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/fRaXjaIhlPuB-R-vp4pPeoGZlftvdgXSxyn6Q2rF42Kvv67ncid10g7lK3I8Ts0KBOUtWU1e_TFh69Ct3Yd7iXz5hetANX31x3M_throOc-8gj_ptcYrP0lMRBY1bi8qNHq1cblhhZaZ0YHkqql9Vi2haPe6jLaATcrIrrFWSWPloM1A0RgNH3M1Ze3FRXoV?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. HubSpot CRM**

(Best overall)

- Easy to learn and implement
- Contact management and sales pipelines
- Email tracking and marketing integrations
- Free plan available for up to 2 users

Best for teams wanting an all-in-one solution.

[Explore HubSpot](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

---

![30MPC Masterclass | Pipedrive](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/YXtK01sDnPYRmrgl-cq3FoFz_gi03_11mtWIHg1kzW5LP-eLYfON-4AW8Be22mb410EXqHg1l_NK3GQkL0OnZs_wo-cAhYHW7JLl_VjWui99Y_oYNiabMsX1QWg6He98qMA1qCh9iTsRxLcxXEYyZcd4w83XvE6jKhETG-afSiGIXEQdSFY0k5LqqYHz7Qmi?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Pipedrive**

(Best for sales teams)

- Excellent visual sales pipeline
- Tracks leads, deals and activities
- Helps ensure sales follow-ups happen
- Paid plans start around \$14/user/month (USD, annual billing)

Best for teams focused on converting leads into customers.

[Explore Pipedrive](https://www.pipedrive.com/)

---

![Zoho CRM | CompareCamp.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/rP2gtcV7Nlyy6nXUMOQjzyN_wQygL4xaXQMp2d5k-DoSGEQMsEN3hNJ0WNTyKAitlOjia4fZYdphTCioyhHisHXlu36u8iQl1HSsfanhh1kEZHqS68G9jkpPxXqg-dHYtj48gIqS7_vCEJPZlinwqT9TxWpB9AntTVPUjoCPxYTyNW38E7xr6UJ6QSvz6_wN?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho CRM**

(Best value)

- Extensive customization
- Sales automation and reporting
- Free plan for up to 3 users
- Paid plans start around \$14/user/month (USD, annual billing)

Best for businesses wanting flexibility without a huge software budget.

[Explore Zoho CRM](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

---

![Freshsales – AI-Powered CRM for Efficient Sales & Customer Management – Daidu.ai](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/y7Vb4xAcRAAEuqjagQXpFAF7AnuXMUElBxy4BgPXr8eZYF7Dkte6UvmlzH7N7Gng8CLjCWbvU78ky87jsrjvYxdASFZf0fX5TJAm3axZjmliiRYYmBFh9H4s49unQfi71zpX0ByRdXwVVL50YsRCn7JH7nOSk0tgkqnFMggeUC_Qb730HNfnItPlsuAKqMt-?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Freshsales**

- Built-in phone, email and chat features
- Lead scoring and sales automation
- Affordable entry-level plans
- Growth starts around \$9/user/month (USD, annual billing)

Best for teams that communicate with customers frequently.

[Explore Freshsales](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/sales/)

---

![Less Annoying CRM Software - CRM Pricing, Demo & Comparisons](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RTr7AVj7MeS-OL5WQum3SxwfQFDxGpatNKnAUpz68rcNbAeIaUs-ya1rHrAfAHzw2hH3AEV967lw9L8dRg_YaRr4o3l8eRPv83jI8PgW-a2ngO7_uVmGymZQiAjvKdG06WIua-EPR9bTbGasxBYwxZxMdUESSM5Gn1izyDroxOyF70que6_QchmIVQu-koWx?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Less Annoying CRM**

- Extremely simple interface
- Contact and task management
- Straightforward pricing around \$15/user/month (USD)
- Minimal learning curve

Best for very small teams that don't need complicated features.

[Explore Less Annoying CRM](https://www.lessannoyingcrm.com/)
